en.headline: Ten injured after minibus collides with water tanker in Kwun Tong
en.dek: Police said the accident occurred near Yue Man Square Public Transport Terminal shortly after midday on Monday; three of the injured were classified as serious but non-life-threatening.
body: At least ten people were injured when a public minibus collided with a water tanker near the Yue Man Square Public Transport Terminal in Kwun Tong on Monday.

Police received a report of the traffic accident at 12.21 pm involving a minibus and a truck. The force said two male and eight female passengers in the minibus were injured. All were taken to United Christian Hospital.

The Fire Services Department classified three of the injured as yellow under its multiple-casualty tagging system, indicating serious but non-life-threatening injuries, and the remaining seven as green for minor injuries. The incident remains under investigation.

zh.headline: 觀塘小巴與運水車相撞十人受傷
zh.dek: 警方表示，事故於星期一中午過後在裕民坊公共運輸交匯處附近發生，其中三人傷勢被列為嚴重但無生命危險。
body: 星期一中午，一輛公共小巴在觀塘裕民坊公共運輸交匯處附近與一輛運水車相撞，至少十人受傷。
警方於下午12時21分接報有交通意外，涉及一輛小巴及一輛貨車。警方表示，小巴上兩名男乘客及八名女乘客受傷，全部送往基督教聯合醫院治理。
消防處按多人傷亡事故標籤系統，將其中三人列為黃色（嚴重但無生命危險），其餘七人列為綠色（輕傷）。事件仍在調查中。
